entities.summary: Christopher Scott Kyle was a United States Navy SEAL sniper. He served four tours in the Iraq War and was awarded the Global War on Terrorism Service Medal, National Defense Service Medal, and a Combat Action Ribbon. Despite Kyle’s claims of receiving two Silver Stars and five Bronze Stars, the Navy later stated that his retirement paperwork was inaccurate and clarified that he had been awarded one Silver Star and three Bronze Star Medals with "V" devices for valor.
